description.value:
Activate 1 (manipulate)

This bite-sized rectangular honey or ginger patisserie is a common fey amusement often coated with multicolored sugar crystals. When you consume a fairy cake, a random part of your body morphs into a caricature of yourself (such as an elongated nose or tiny hands). Roll [[/r 1d4 #Fairy Cakes]] to determine the area of the body it affects:

  1. head

  2. appendages

  3. torso

  4. skin.

This transformation lasts for 1 hour, during which you gain a +2 status bonus to Deception checks to [[/act impersonate]] a creature other than yourself.
